beats.headline: Asleep in the road
beats.text: For the record: Tsarina Signet has captured Heather multiple times, always to kill the sacrifice, and has never yet used her blood to summon her team. Tonight Crawler Carl is to kill Heather. Her blood is not as powerful as his, Signet says, but it is some of the most potent she has used. She lies asleep in the road under the same Water Lily spell as Crawler Donut. Once a black bear. Pink clown hat and ruff grown into her body, no skin on her face, red eyes, front paws turned to white worms, roller skates, a pink tutu.

beats.headline: Performing since she was a cub
beats.text: Heather the Bear. Level 19 Neighborhood Boss. Performing since she was a cub, Heather the Roller-Skating Bear was one of the longest-running attractions at Grimaldi's Traveling Circus, with retirement weeks away when the cataclysm hit. Now she hunts for the circus, running down mobs and crawlers and dragging them back so the clowns may feed. A spark of the old Heather survives deep down, and she has moments of lucidity. In them she thinks: "I've always hated all you assholes, anyway."

beats.headline: Worms that talk
beats.text: On her skates she stands about eight feet tall. From fifteen feet away she whips the worms at Crawler Carl and wraps him three times; they burrow into his bare legs and talk inside his head about primal flesh and hungry clowns. Protective Shell severs them and blows her fifty feet back. A thrown jug of moonshine and a torch set her alight. She trips on a dumbbell, sheds half her skin and fur, and comes on as a skeleton wrapped in worms, with half her health left.

beats.headline: Custard, not fireball
beats.text: Crawler Carl scratches a lottery ticket saved for a dire moment: a level-15 fireball or strawberry custard, fifty-fifty. Custard. It heals her, and the healing kills the worms. Her skin and fur re-form; the roller skates and the hat fall off and turn to dust. What sits down on all fours is an elderly black bear with a silver sheen on her muzzle, free of the parasites. Without them her body is breaking down fast. Her eyes, by his reading, say: end it. I should never have lived this long.

beats.headline: Two punches and a heel
beats.text: Heather the Bear, Level 19 Neighborhood Boss, is dead. Crawler Carl kept an eye on her claws, found no trick, and finished it: two quick punches to the head, then his foot pressed down on her skull until it caved. Winner. It is his first solo boss battle, and he reaches level 15. A line of red rises from the corpse and flies to Tsarina Signet. Looted from the remains: a neighborhood map upgrade.

beats.headline: She was family
beats.text: Signet's retinue rises on Heather's blood, strength bought with shorter lives: dozens of paper elementals in red outline. Signet thanks Crawler Carl. He actually freed Heather tonight, she says. For two centuries the bear had been caught in that loop. A grumpy old bear; Signet told Grimaldi more than once she would snap and try to eat a spectator if they did not retire her. But she was family. At the big top, the blood is not enough: Signet had hoped it would break the tent's protection, and it does not.

beats.headline: What her boss box held
beats.text: Loot note. Sorting his rewards, Crawler Carl opens what came out of the bronze boss box from his fight with Heather: a whole box of hobgoblin dynamite and three globs of Hobgoblin Pus, the remote-controlled explosive detonators. He has never seen hobgoblin dynamite before. The sticks are white instead of red, with a larger yield, and much more stable. Mordecai's advice on the trap supplies he has also been collecting: leave them alone until there is a sapper's table.

beats.headline: Like the bear
beats.text: Asked what became of the circus, Tsarina Signet uses Heather as the measure. Grimaldi killed the parasites and set their family free. It was like when Carl freed Heather the bear: all the clowns and lemurs and other performers simply crumbled away, finally free. All but Grimaldi himself, whom Signet took with her.
